entities.summary: Dominic David Rene Smith, is an American professional baseball first baseman and left fielder for the Atlanta Braves of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the New York Mets, Washington Nationals, Boston Red Sox, Cincinnati Reds, and San Francisco Giants. He was selected by the Mets with the 11th overall pick of the 2013 MLB draft, and made his MLB debut in 2017.
